name: homehub

scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec -- rm -rf node_modules .turbo 2>/dev/null || true && rm -rf node_modules .turbo && rm -f pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.deploy:int: pnpm sst deploy --stage int && pnpm simulator:deploy
scripts.deploy:int:recover: bash scripts/cleanup-simulator-orphans.sh int && pnpm sst deploy --stage int && pnpm simulator:deploy
scripts.test:api: uv sync --all-packages --dev && uv run --directory packages/rest-api pytest
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

description: HomeHub — smart home IoT hub with REST API, DynamoDB, Cognito, and SST IaC
